name: faucet
description: Skills for writing, running, debugging and deploying faucet-stream data pipelines, Template Hub templates and connector crates. The version equals the faucet-cli release it ships with.

interface.longDescription: Skills for faucet-stream: author pipeline YAML that passes validation, diagnose failed, slow or lagging runs, deploy and migrate, compose and publish Template Hub templates, and implement faucet-source-* / faucet-sink-* crates.
